said: It looks great. Please replace and make it driveable
findingsShown: under the bow: a small see-through sliver where the collar bends tightest (0.28% of the bottom view); below the waterline
seats: helm plus four, where the reference has nine; simplified on purpose
windscreen: a solid dark slab, not see-through glass
radar arch: a plain A-frame with a light bar, beacon and dome; the reference arch is curved with a horn
colour: collar and hull are close shades of near-black, so the boat reads as one dark shape from a distance
no realistic version to compare: the generator's GPU quota ran out before any mesh was made
